title: GovernanceProposalVoteCastEvent
description: Published when a vote is cast on a governance proposal. Consumed by the GraphQL `proposalVoteCast` subscription (backend/src/graphql/resolvers.ts, SUBSCRIPTION_TOPICS.proposalVoteCast).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for this event type. Bump on breaking changes.

creatorAddress.description: Owning token's creator address, used for tenant scoping (TenantScopedPayload).

support.description: Whether the vote is in support (true) or against (false) the proposal.

weight.description: Voting power of the voter — stringified bigint (string) or raw bigint depending on the publisher; type intentionally unconstrained since JSON Schema has no bigint primitive.

votesFor.description: Total votes in favor after this vote — stringified bigint (string) or raw bigint depending on the publisher; type intentionally unconstrained since JSON Schema has no bigint primitive.

votesAgainst.description: Total votes against after this vote — stringified bigint (string) or raw bigint depending on the publisher; type intentionally unconstrained since JSON Schema has no bigint primitive.

reason.description: Optional reason provided with the vote.
